title: Hope you make your mind up. ( ps reading books are amazing for you READ😭)
body:
Honestly, this app doesn’t do much — it’s you who puts in the work to destroy your bad habits. This is merely a tracker of your successes and your failures. However, it gives you a glimpse of hope each time you relapse and have to reset your timer.

You’re left in disbelief, realising how consistent you can be in repeating the same negative action — whether that’s smoking, taking drugs, drinking alcohol, self-harming, or even masturbating for some. The point still stands: you’re struck by such disbelief that you’re almost forced to change. And that’s what I love about it.

It’s a tracker for both your progress and your setbacks, allowing you to grow. Of course, nothing’s perfect — I dislike that some simple features are locked behind a paywall, which feels absurd. But overall, it’s up to you: download it or don’t.

The only reason I have marked this down to 4 stars is because I think it would be better if there was an option where instead of automatically setting you back to day 1, that you can mark something as a blip.  If you’re trying to quit anything, say alcohol, you haven’t touched alcohol in 8 months for example, then suddenly you slip and get drunk for one night, or even just have one beer and stop, and then carry on, to reset that counter to zero I think can seem demoralising.  You’ve done really well to get as far as you have and seeing that counter reset to zero, really can negatively affect your belief and motivation.  I do think you should be able to reset but I think also it works be helpful to be able to mark your blip. Having one beer will not take away all the good you’ve done, destroying your motivation could. Some could misuse the blip counter do I still think resetting to zero should be an option

title: Great for Tracking Habits, but Needs an Export Feature
body:
I’ve been using Days Since to track my habits, and I find the app’s simplicity one of its greatest strengths. It allows me to manage multiple goals effortlessly, with a clear color-coded system that makes tracking intuitive and effective. I also really appreciate the journaling feature, which lets me document each reset with detailed notes. Sometimes, I add extensive comments, which helps me reflect and stay accountable.

However, I can’t give the app five stars because it lacks an option to export notes. For instance, if I’ve kept a year’s worth of notes under a specific counter, there’s no way to export them for review outside the app. Adding this feature would not only make the app more functional but also encourage users like me to continue using it for detailed journaling without worrying about losing access to important reflections. I highly urge the developers to consider implementing this, as it would elevate the app’s usability significantly.

I’ve struggled with addiction issues for almost half of my life, staying sober can be really difficult at times but with this app I can check how many days I’m on and I really don’t want to break my hard work because I can see it constantly going up. It’s helped me massively so I recommend it to anyone experiencing similar issues, I also recommend talking to your GP who can point you in the right direction for local substance abuse services.
Now I’m sober I’m thinking about using it to cut bad foods out of my diet, starting with gluten, dairy, refined sugars etc

title: Great app, but I have a feature request!
body:
Love the simplicity and ease of use of the app. It’s got a great user experience and design, not trying to pack too much in to what should be a simple way of tracking goals and sobriety. 

I have a feature request. I would love to be able to set a goal date, and a reward for reaching that goal. For behaviour change to be most effective, it helps to have a goal to aim for, whether that be treating yourself to a gift, or just a pat on the back. I would love to be able to set a goal of XXX days/weeks/months etc, and set a reward (e.g. buy a new gadget). Once that date is met I get a notification with permission to get my reward! 

Thanks
